cues.zh: 好吧，你讨厌它们，是因为

cues.zh: 而且每次改点东西它们就挂，那你开始怀疑它们是否值得，也是合情合理的。

cues.zh: 大家都说你应该有测试，

cues.zh: 它们也许……它们大概偶尔能帮你一把，刚好让你不敢把它们全删了。

cues.en: But the cold hard truth is they make you miserable.
cues.zh: 但冷酷的真相是，它们让你痛苦不堪。

cues.en: If this is where you are right now, you are not alone.
cues.zh: 如果你现在正处于这种境地，你并不孤单。

cues.en: For many people, the promise of testing has not been fulfilled.
cues.zh: 对很多人来说，测试的承诺并没有兑现。

cues.en: And fortunately,
cues.zh: 而幸运的是，

cues.en: it doesn't have to be this way.
cues.zh: 事情不必如此。

cues.en: You can have cost effective tests. Good tests aren't magic, they're magic tricks. And since they're tricks, you can learn them.
cues.zh: 你可以拥有高性价比的测试。好的测试不是魔法，而是魔术。既然是魔术，你就能学会。

cues.en: There's just a few tricks. They're simple and straightforward. They're not obvious,
cues.zh: 就那么几个窍门。它们简单直接，虽然不那么显而易见，

cues.en: but they are simple. And I'm gonna tell you these tricks in the next twenty eight minutes.

cues.en: And for most of you, they're gonna involve some form of every programmer's favorite thing,
cues.zh: 对你们大多数人来说，它们会涉及每个程序员最爱的事情，

cues.en: deleting tests.
cues.zh: 删测试。

cues.en: I think you have too many tests and you're testing the wrong sorts of things, or at least you did back when you wrote tests.
cues.zh: 我觉得你的测试太多了，而且测错了东西，至少你当初写测试的时候是这样。

cues.en: You wrote too many tests and that was so painful that now that you... Now you write too few or none at all.
cues.zh: 你写了太多的测试，过程痛苦至极，以至于现在……现在你写得极少，甚至根本不写。

cues.en: So today's talk is about unit tests.
cues.zh: 所以今天的演讲是关于单元测试的。

cues.en: The magic tricks apply to unit tests.
cues.zh: 这些小把戏适用于单元测试。

There's a big cloud that's your app, and an integration test like you poke one side and a bunch of objects and messages go, and then the answer... Some change comes out the other, and the integration test does the poke and checks the distant
cues.zh: 这次演讲不是关于集成测试的。集成测试就是端到端测试。对吧？有一大片云。我知道你不能……我觉得我得上下蹦跶。有一大片云代表你的应用，集成测试就像你戳一下这一头，一堆对象和消息开始运作，然后答案……另一头会产出某种变化，而集成测试就是去戳一下并检查远处的

cues.en: side effect.
cues.zh: 副作用。

cues.en: Unit tests are just the opposite. They narrow the focus down until the entire universe is a single object.
cues.zh: 单元测试则恰恰相反。它们将焦点缩小，直到整个宇宙只剩下一个对象。

cues.en: And that object is all unit test knows about.
cues.zh: 而这个对象就是单元测试所了解的全部。

cues.en: So at a molecular
cues.zh: 所以在分子

cues.en: level,
cues.zh: 级别上，

cues.en: your unit test proves
cues.zh: 你的单元测试能够证明

cues.en: that every cell
cues.zh: 每一个细胞

cues.en: behaves correctly.
cues.zh: 的行为都是正确的。

cues.en: And the integration test is is proof that the beast is alive.
cues.zh: 而集成测试则是证明这个庞然大物还活着。

cues.en: So so this is what we want out of unit tests.
cues.zh: 所以，这就是我们对单元测试的诉求。

cues.en: We want them to be thorough.
cues.zh: 我们希望它们是全面的。

cues.en: We want them to prove logically and completely that that single object under test is behaving correctly.
cues.zh: 我们希望它们能在逻辑上彻底地证明被测的那个单一对象行为正确。

cues.en: We want them to be stable.
cues.zh: 我们希望它们是稳定的。

cues.en: We don't want the test to break every time we change an implementation detail in the code.
cues.zh: 我们不希望每次修改代码中的实现细节时测试就崩溃。

cues.en: We'd like them to be fast because we know what happens when they are not.
cues.zh: 我们希望它们速度快，因为我们深知当它们不够快时会发生什么。

cues.en: And we want them to be few. We want the code that we write for tests to be the most parsimonious
cues.zh: 我们希望它们数量少。我们希望为测试编写的代码是最经济、最简练的

cues.en: expression
cues.zh: 证明

cues.en: of the proofs. We don't want extra lines of unnecessary test code that we have to maintain.
cues.zh: 表达式。我们不希望有任何需要维护的、不必要的冗余测试代码。

cues.en: So thorough, stable, fast, few. This is what we're looking for in our unit tests.
cues.zh: 彻底、稳定、快速、数量少。这就是我们对单元测试的追求。

cues.en: And achieving this, finding this takes a sort of clarity vision about your application.
cues.zh: 要做到这一点、找到这种测试，需要对你的应用有清晰的洞察。

cues.en: So do a thought experiment for me. Close your eyes if you have to. So imagine an app that you're working on right now and construct
cues.zh: 所以跟我做个思维实验。有必要的话闭上眼睛。想象一个你正在开发的应用，在脑海中构建

cues.en: a picture of it in your mind, like the... Not the files on disk, but the running app in memory.
cues.zh: 它的画面，不是磁盘上的文件，而是内存中运行的应用。

cues.en: The objects and the messages that are passing between, like draw a picture in your head of that pattern.
cues.zh: 对象以及它们之间传递的消息，在脑中画出这种模式的图。

cues.en: What does it look like?
cues.zh: 它看起来像什么？

cues.en: Yeah. Spaghetti.
cues.zh: 对，一团乱麻。

cues.en: For many of us it looks like this.
cues.zh: 对我们很多人来说，它就是这样的。

cues.en: Our applications grow up into these complicated tangles of code. And when our apps feel like this, it's no wonder that tests escape our control. We don't understand
cues.zh: 我们的应用逐渐长成这些复杂的代码纠缠。当应用给人这种感觉时，测试脱离我们的掌控也就不足为奇了。我们根本不明白

cues.en: what's going on.
cues.zh: 发生了什么。

cues.en: And the way out of this thicket
cues.zh: 而走出这片迷雾的方法

cues.en: is to follow the message.
cues.zh: 就是跟随消息。

cues.en: And the magic tricks I'm about to show you, they focus on messages.
cues.zh: 我接下来要展示的魔法技巧，都聚焦于消息。

cues.en: And fortunately, the objects that we're gonna unit test, they have a really simple view of messages.
cues.zh: 幸运的是，我们要做单元测试的对象，对消息的看法非常简单。

cues.en: Objects are black boxes. They're like space capsules.
cues.zh: 对象是黑盒。它们就像太空舱。

cues.en: They have an inside and an outside,
cues.zh: 有内部和外部，

cues.en: and they are very motivated to keep these those two things apart.
cues.zh: 而且它们极力把这两者隔开。

cues.en: The cold, dark, lonely outside is dangerous,
cues.zh: 寒冷、黑暗、孤独的外部是危险的，

cues.en: and it's a matter of life and death to maintain a clear separation between outside and in.
cues.zh: 保持内外清晰分隔是生死攸关的事。

cues.en: So from the point of view of the object under test,
cues.zh: 所以从被测对象的角度来看，

cues.en: it only knows a few things about messages. It doesn't matter how many you have or how complicated they are. Every message it knows about comes from one of three places.
cues.zh: 它对消息只知道几件事。你有多少消息、消息多复杂都不重要。它知道的每条消息都来自三个地方之一。

cues.en: The object under test receives messages from others. These are incoming messages. These incoming messages blast holes in the containment wall of the space capsule. You have to be really careful and not let the outside see in.
cues.zh: 被测对象会接收来自其他对象的消息。这些是传入消息。这些传入消息会在太空舱的隔离壁上炸出洞来。你得格外小心，不能让外面看到里面。

cues.en: Next, it sends messages. They're outgoing messages. Again, holes in the containment. You can't let the inside see out.
cues.zh: 接下来，它会发送消息。这些是传出消息。同样，隔离壁上又会出现洞。你不能让里面看到外面。

cues.en: The third place where messages originate
cues.zh: 消息来源的第三个地方

cues.en: is the object under test sends them to itself.
cues.zh: 是被测对象自己给自己发消息。

cues.en: Now these messages are completely contained within the space capsule. They're invisible
cues.zh: 这些消息完全被封装在太空舱内。它们对

cues.en: to anything on the outside.
cues.zh: 外面的任何东西都是不可见的。

cues.en: So here's what we have. These are the three origins of messages
cues.zh: 所以情况就是这样。从被测对象的角度来看，

cues.en: from point of view of the object under test.
cues.zh: 这就是消息的三个来源。

cues.en: And then these messages, they come in two flavors types.
cues.zh: 然后这些消息分为两种类型。

cues.en: They can be queries
cues.zh: 它们可以是查询

cues.en: or commands.
cues.zh: 或命令。

cues.en: A query message
cues.zh: 查询消息

cues.en: you run a... A query message doesn't have side effects.
cues.zh: 你执行一个……查询消息没有副作用。

cues.en: So if you were to send plus to an integer, a calculation is often a really good example of a query message. Right? You care about the thing you get back, but it doesn't change anything that any other part of your app can see.
cues.zh: 所以如果你向一个整数发送 plus，计算通常是查询消息的一个很好的例子。对吧？你关心的是返回的结果，但它不会改变应用其他任何部分能看到的东西。

cues.en: In contrast, command messages are really just the opposite. A command message has a side effect, but but returns nothing that you depend on. So sending save to a subclass of active record would be a command message. Right? Writes in the database and all the other parts of your app can see that.
cues.zh: 相反，命令消息正好相反。命令消息有副作用，但不返回任何你依赖的东西。所以向 active record 的子类发送 save 就是一条命令消息。对吧？会写入数据库，而你应用的其他所有部分都能看到这一点。

cues.en: Every programmer here has probably been burned
cues.zh: 在座的每位程序员可能都曾被坑过

cues.en: by a message that was both a query and a command.
cues.zh: 被那种既是查询又是命令的消息坑过。

cues.en: You go to a code base you don't know very well, they tell you to make a change. You go find a likely message that gives you the result that you want. You use that message in your code, you deploy it into production, and then later you overhear someone wondering why you just sent 10,000 emails.
cues.zh: 你接手一个不太熟悉的代码库，有人让你改点东西。你找到一个看起来合适的消息，它能给你想要的结果。你在代码里用了它，部署到生产环境，后来却无意中听到有人在纳闷你为什么刚发了一万封邮件。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 对吧？

cues.en: Like, I don't expect... Those hidden side effects are the bane of programmers. Now
cues.zh: 我是说，我没料到……这些隐藏的副作用是程序员的心头大患。那么

cues.en: so what... It it... However, it is it is just... We do this all the time. We have to conflate
cues.zh: 那又怎样……它它……不过，它它只是……我们一直都在这么干。我们不得不把

cues.en: command and query. The perfect example is popping something off a queue.
cues.zh: 命令和查询混在一起。最典型的例子就是从队列里弹出元素。

cues.en: It's really hard to think of a way to separate those. I... When I say pop, I get the thing back.
cues.zh: 真的很难想出办法把它们分开。我……我说 pop 的时候，元素就返回给我了。

cues.en: Right? That's the query part. And it changes the queue so that other parts of my app if they look at the queue, they see a difference. That's the command part.
cues.zh: 对吧？这是查询的部分。而它改变了队列，所以我应用的其他部分如果查看队列，就会看到不同。这是命令的部分。

cues.en: So it isn't evil
cues.zh: 所以把命令和查询混在一起

cues.en: to conflate command and queries. And we do it all the time in Ruby especially since there's always an automatic return which makes it easy to chain messages together. Right? That that's gonna happen in our code bases. However, these things get tested
cues.zh: 并不是什么邪恶的事。我们一直都这么干，尤其在 Ruby 里，因为总有自动返回值，这让消息链接变得很容易。对吧？这在我们的代码库里是必然发生的。不过，这些东西的测试方式

cues.en: differently.
cues.zh: 是不一样的。

cues.en: And so it's really important to understand if you have a command or a query or both.
cues.zh: 所以弄清楚你手头的是命令、查询还是两者兼有，非常重要。
